officialApp.name: None documented
officialApp.notes: Sordin does not document a companion app for the Supreme X2 BT. Settings and Bluetooth pairing are handled with the cup keypad. Sordin's configuration app (Sordin Share) is documented for the Sharp, not for the X2 BT.

battery.chargingIndicators: Low-battery warning; Sordin does not publish percentage steps or LED thresholds for this model.
battery.notes: One combined headset battery: a single AA cell. No charging case. Sordin positions this as a 'single-battery solution' with four-hour auto shutdown, but the product page captured does not state runtime hours.

anc.notes: No ANC. Passive hearing protection (SNR 29 / NRR 23) plus level-dependent ambient amplification limited to 82 dB(A). This is an electronic shooting/hunting protector, not an ANC headset.

officialApp.name: Sordin Share
officialApp.notes: Sordin Share is the configuration app for Sordin Sharp: users can change several headset settings, and managers can predefine user settings across an organisation. It is not a battery-percentage app. Sordin also lists a Sordin Share manual alongside the Sharp manual.

battery.chargingIndicators: Low-battery warning/voice feedback; no percentage steps published.
battery.notes: One combined headset battery: built-in 2000 mAh rechargeable lithium-ion. Approximately 36 hours. USB-C charging; a 60-minute charge gives at least 8 hours. No charging case. Automatic power-off prevents accidental drain.

anc.notes: No ANC. Passive protection (SNR 28–29 depending on cushion) plus level-dependent Ambient Sound and Push-to-Listen. The level-dependent output is limited for hearing protection.
